Triage: lands in `domain:ui` · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:ux · Feature · comments (1) desktop: comments leave the activity tab and become a side panel on the record page and drawer, with one place for a comment's actions; phase 1 of topic #36062 → p2 as set by the coordinator · size L (the claimant may split).

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Claim: PM loop · 2026-11-21T13:21Z · area b1-CM (epic #36062 phase 1; the maintainer took the epic for this seat on its decision card).
Area: b1-CM
Session: `session_01L6bhgXXdtDHm8mLZYX8Bsb` (card thread)
Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/project-thread-ks7hy1
Seat: `repo:objectstack#1`
Domain: `domain:ui`
File surface: new `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/comments/*` (`useRecordComments`, `CommentItem`, `CommentThread`, `CommentComposer`, `CommentFilterMenu`, `CommentsButton`, desktop `CommentsPanel` and `CommentHoverActions`) and the plugin-detail entry exports; `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`, `renderers/record-activity.tsx`, `recordTimelineStream.ts`; app-shell `RecordDetailView.tsx`, `recordDrawerStack.tsx`; components `record-top-bar.tsx`, `navigation-overlay.tsx` (an optional slot each); react `DiscussionContext.tsx`; new i18n keys in every locale; tests, changesets. No governed surface, no `packages/spec`.
Container & model: `L`, card thread, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (widening) (new plugin-detail exports; optional fields on `RecordTopBar`, `NavigationOverlay` and `DiscussionContextValue`; nothing removed or renamed; the seat runs the declaration-face L2)
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise (thread, read on main `493ad095`, file `build-seat1/36075/premise-read.md` in the project folder): holds. The comment data lives in `RecordDetailView` behind `DiscussionContextProvider`, and the drawer embeds the same view, so page and drawer already share data.
Basis: card #36075 (mock-ups approved by the maintainer); epic #36062.
Scope, the seat's reading: the card's nine items. Panel 380 wide; at a window of 1280 or more the content gives way, below it the panel overlays; in the drawer, a split at 760 or more and an overlay of the drawer body below that; open state kept per page and per drawer. The header icon sits in the record row before Edit, through one optional slot each in `RecordTopBar` and `NavigationOverlay`; objects with feeds off show none. The Activity tab drops comments on desktop page and drawer only (phones keep them until #36076). The count is top-level comments until #36071 merges. One open question goes to the maintainer separately: what happens on the six pages whose authors placed their own activity or discussion block.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial behind #36070 (same files; merge main after it lands and reuse its avatar, reply focus and delete toast) and #36071 (resolved UI wired after it merges, or a second PR if it is slow). `overlap-check.mjs` before each push. L1 at L1-c. The PR carries `Fixes #36075`.
